description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order to amend the Gaz.Ex.Ord. No. 1482/26 of 02.04.2007 adding Departments to the Faculty of Arts, University of Peradeniya
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of university faculties and departments through a legal order under the Universities Act. It contains a statutory instrument that modifies the schedule of an existing order, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes. The mention of the minister's name is incidental to the regulatory action being taken.
